name: vfx-liquid-glass
title: Liquid Glass Wall
description: A wall of 3D glass shards (Voronoi fracture, physical glass with refraction, bloom and grain) floats in front of a brand page - red caps badge, Bebas headline with a red second line, text and three numbers - and parts around a wandering point to reveal it, for 20 s. Badge, headline, text, numbers and labels are variables; the glass keeps its own colours; holds or fades.
